lines.text: Hi, I'm Bloop! Look, I can change my colors! Let's sing the Colors Song!
I can change, one, two, three!
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Here's a fun fact! Mix blue paint and yellow paint, and you make green!
Green grass, green leaf, green bean!
I can change, one, two, three!
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Blue and purple, what a team!
All the colors, look and see,
Make a rainbow, you and me!
I can change, one, two, three!
Red and yellow, green and blue,
I can change, one, two, three!
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Yay! You know your colors! Sing it again tomorrow! Bye-bye!
